ev.q: VVVVVV is a 2010 puzzle-platform game created by Terry Cavanagh
VVVVVV is a 2010 puzzle-platform game created by Terry Cavanagh
Due to its high level of difficulty
the game's trial and error moments can seriously test one's patience
the game's challenge is made less frustrating due to its numerous checkpoints
These are situated inside a large open world for the player to explore
